title: Looks Nice
description: A high-end Minecraft graphics overhaul merging photorealistic textures, cinematic shaders, and hyper-detailed animations for next-level visuals.
body:
# Looks Nice
Looks Nice is a tightly curated Fabric modpack built for one purpose alone: to push Minecraft's graphical fidelity to its absolute limit. By combining hyper-detailed resource packs, advanced rendering technologies, and a suite of performance-focused mods, we deliver a stunning, next-generation visual experience that's as smooth as it is beautiful. 

With Looks Nice, you will explore a Minecraft world that feels more immersive, dynamic, and cinematic than ever before.

## 🔥 Ultimate Visual Overhaul
Experience Minecraft at its breathtaking best. We have meticulously selected and configured every mod to ensure a seamless visual upgrade.

### 🖼️ Breathtaking Shaders & Graphics
Complementary Shaders v4 is the shader pack for Minecraft Java Edition with exceptional attention to detail, high standards of quality, and top-tier optimisation. It offers a ton of high quality effects, two default visual style choices, custom effects for almost every block in the game, with profiles ranging from Potato to Ultra. The **Unbound style** is designed for people looking for a more realistic experience, while the **Reimagined style** is made to reimagine Minecraft while preserving its unique visual elements.

This modpack uses **Iris** as the shader loader, together with **Sodium** (and **Sodium Extra**) and **Lithium** for extreme rendering performance, while **ImmediatelyFast** and **FerriteCore** ensure near-instant loading times and drastically reduced memory usage.

### 🌌 Infinite View Distances
One of the most revolutionary features in the pack is **Voxy**, a revolutionary LoD rendering mod that extends your render distance far beyond vanilla limits by rendering distant terrain at lower detail levels, view distant mountains and structures without the lag of traditional chunk loading.

### ✨ Cinematic Animations & Details
This pack brings Minecraft to life with fluid and custom animations:
*   The **Fresh Animations** and **Fresh Animations: Extensions** resource packs completely overhaul creature and character animations.
*   **Fresh Moves** transforms how your character moves in Minecraft, adding smooth, dynamic, and immersive movement variations to idle, walking, and swimming animations while keeping the classic vanilla style.
*   **Visuality** adds a wide mix of new particles – things like crystal sparkles, extra hit particles, and subtle environmental visuals that make the world feel less static.
*   For the player, **3d-Skin-Layers** and **Capes** add realistic volumetric layers, and **Chat Heads** show facial expressions in chat.

### 🔍 Photorealistic World Textures
We use the high-resolution **RCG (x64)** resource pack, a high-definition realistic texture pack designed to enhance every block and item feel more immersive and captivating. This, combined with **Continuity** for connected textures, **Entity Texture Features** for expanded data-driven entity textures, and **Entity Model Features** for custom animated entity models, makes every surface look hyper-detailed.

## ⚡ Smooth & Optimised Performance
While offering extreme graphics, Looks Nice is designed to be highly performant. It includes a full suite of optimisation mods:
*   **EntityCulling**: Stop rendering entities that aren't visible, significantly improving FPS in crowded areas.
*   **More Culling**: Improves performance by aggressively culling air blocks, leaves, and other transparent content outside the player's view.
*   **Remove Reloading Screen**: Makes resource pack reloading instant, removing that annoying black screen.
*   **FerriteCore** & **Lithium**: Aggressively reduce memory usage and improve general game physics and AI performance.

## 📦 Complete Package

### ⚙️ Included Mods
*   *Rendering:*
  3d-Skin-Layers, Capes, Chat Heads, Cloth Config v20, Continuity, Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features, EntityCulling, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, FerriteCore, Forge Config API Port, ImmediatelyFast, Iris, Lithium, Mod Menu, More Culling, Placeholder API, Remove Reloading Screen, Sodium, Sodium Extra, Visuality, Voxy, YetAnotherConfigLib, Zoomify

*   **Fresh Moves**
